name: testing_01
description: Проект для автоматизированного тестирования интернет-магазина с использованием **Playwright**.

scripts.report: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.allure:smoke: npm run test:smoke && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.allure:clean: if exist allure-results rmdir /s /q allure-results && if exist allure-report rmdir /s /q allure-report
scripts.allure: npm run allure:clean && npm run test:allure && npm run report
scripts.report:allure: allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && allure open allure-report
scripts.allure:full: npm run allure:clean && npm run test:allure && npm run report:allure
